cohort: A cohort of 1,477,062 singleton live births in the United States in 2018.
finding: Both prepregnancy obesity (PPO) and excessive gestational weight gain (eGWG) were independently associated with preterm delivery and LGA infants, while PPO, with or without eGWG, was also linked to low Apgar scores, increased NICU admissions, and a greater need for immediate ventilatory support.
